{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "credit_amount_per_month",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average credit amount per month of duration.",
      "value_range": [3.4, 4606.0],
      "feature_family": "financial_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized measure of monthly financial burden, which helps tree models split on actual cash flow impact rather than just total amount.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "credit_amount / duration"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal categorization of age into four distinct life stages.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "demographic_grouping",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups age into ordinal buckets, allowing tree models to easily isolate specific life stages without needing multiple splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(age < 25, 0, np.where(age < 40, 1, np.where(age < 60, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_high_credit_amount",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for credit amounts exceeding 5000.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "threshold_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Flags large loans, providing a direct boolean split for high-value credit applications.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(credit_amount > 5000, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "installment_duration_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of installment commitment and loan duration.",
      "value_range": [4, 288],
      "feature_family": "interaction_term",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the interaction between installment rate and loan duration, representing the total time-weighted commitment.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "installment_commitment * duration"
    },
    {
      "name": "has_no_checking",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for applicants without a checking account.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "categorical_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Isolates applicants without a checking account, a key categorical grouping for financial profiling.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(checking_status == 'no checking', 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_young_and_renting",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for applicants under 30 who rent their housing.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "interaction_term",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies young applicants who rent, a non-linear interaction of age and housing status that tree models can use directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((age < 30) & (housing == 'rent'), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall financial health based on savings status, checking status, and credit history.",
      "value_range": [0, 10],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, monotonic representation of financial stability, reducing the need for the tree to learn complex multi-way splits across several categorical variables.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "loan_purpose_risk_profile",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Evaluates the inherent riskiness of the loan purpose combined with the requested amount and duration.",
      "value_range": [1, 5],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates high-cardinality categorical purpose into an ordinal risk scale, simplifying splits for the tree model.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "total_commitments",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of existing credits and number of dependents.",
      "value_range": [2, 6],
      "feature_family": "additive_aggregation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines existing credits and dependents into a single integer representing total structural commitments.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "existing_credits + num_dependents"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_per_age",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of credit amount to applicant age.",
      "value_range": [3.3, 970.0],
      "feature_family": "financial_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Calculates the ratio of credit amount to age, highlighting unusually large loans for younger individuals.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "credit_amount / age"
    },
    {
      "name": "social_stability_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic evaluation of social and residential stability based on employment, housing, personal status, and residence duration.",
      "value_range": [0, 10],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates multiple demographic and lifestyle factors into a single ordinal feature, providing a strong, unified signal for tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "has_guarantor_or_coapplicant",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for the presence of a guarantor or co-applicant.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "categorical_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Flags the presence of a guarantor or co-applicant, providing a direct boolean indicator of external financial backing.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(other_parties != 'none', 1, 0)"
    }
  ]
}
